title: Signal Fragments: 7,000 cr once, accepted at Central Nexus, a dock at Node Beta and at Node Gamma, handed in at Central Nexus
note: Researcher Null-Seven's exploration mission on the Central Nexus board: three dock_at_base objectives at our own stations, 7,000 cr once per pilot, nothing handed out and nothing bought. Test by hand 2026-11-16 04:50 UTC, one trader: accepted at Central Nexus, Node Beta and Node Gamma recorded on docking, handed in at Central Nexus, +6,909 cr after 91 cr of fuel in 14 minutes (RESULT line, data/routes/runs.jsonl). Offered only to pilots with navigation 3 or more: the Central Nexus board read for each of 30 docked pilots at about 05:28 UTC listed it for 4 of 4 with navigation 3 and 0 of 25 with navigation 2; six traders with navigation 2 sent by the plan were refused (05:07 to 05:18 UTC, -26 to -39 cr each). Since 2026-11-16 07:00 UTC the route names `requires.skills` navigation 3 (requests.log ENT-109): the dispatcher sends only a pilot that holds it, so the route may stand in every plan. The next link, The Crimson Resonance (8,500 cr), docks at The Rampart Checkpoint and delivers 5 titanium alloy at Blood Forge, Crimson space 17 to 20 jumps out: not flown. 2026-11-16 08:32 UTC (fill.py, Mercury): max_ships 3 -> 10.
